meta_data.base_class: Fetch and analyze city-level price trends of specific <assets> - locate designated goods or assets within a city through parameters such as city name, with measurable price fluctuations and growth curves.

tool_template.name: fetch_<class>_price_trends
tool_template.description: Fetches and analyzes the latest <class> price trends for specified cities.

city.description: The city for which to fetch <class> price data.

dataFormat.description: Preferred format for the data output.

timeRange.description: The time range for the price data analysis, such as 'last_week', 'last_month', or 'last_year'.

currency.description: The currency in which the <class> price data should be represented.

aggregationMethod.description: Method for aggregating <class> price data, such as 'average', 'median', or 'mode'.

includeHistoricalData.description: Whether to include historical <class> price data in the analysis.

dataSource.description: Preferred data source for fetching <class> price trends, such as 'government', 'private', or 'open_source'.
